story.title: Useful technology can start with one builder.
paragraphs: SAMUHIA began in Kenya in 2023 with a simple idea: useful technology does not always need to start with a massive institution behind it. It can start with someone identifying a real problem, learning what is required, and building a solution that works.
From that foundation, SAMUHIA has grown into an ecosystem of digital products spanning community finance, payments, property management, education administration and digital services.
story.closing: Built in Kenya. Designed to scale beyond it.

founderTeaser.text: A self-taught developer and technology builder focused on turning practical problems into useful digital systems.

faq.a: SAMUHIA is a Kenyan technology company founded in 2023 that builds practical digital products for businesses, institutions, communities and individuals.
Plot Yangu for property management, MyRegister for school attendance and parent SMS, MyChama for chamas, Samuhia Desk for agents who support them, and Samuhia Payments, the payment layer behind them.
MyRegister is free to use, with SMS tokens available separately when messaging services are required.

faq.q: How do I pay for a plan?
faq.a: By M-Pesa. Each app sends a prompt to your phone and you confirm with your PIN. Payments are processed through Paystack.
SAMUHIA currently operates from Kenya and is building toward broader international expansion.

faq.q: Is there a SAMUHIA WhatsApp number?
faq.a: Yes. The SAMUHIA WhatsApp bot is on +254 101 716 473. Message it to pay rent, get a rent invoice, open My Chama, use Landlord Watch or search House to Rent, in English or Kiswahili. To reach the SAMUHIA team directly, use the details on the Contact page.
